A WebAssembly module imported as an ES module: its exports as bindings, of
every kind, the same instance for every importer, and its source phase.

-- m.wat --
(module
  (func (export "add") (param i32 i32) (result i32) local.get 0 local.get 1 i32.add)
  (global (export "g") i32 (i32.const 7))
  (global (export "mg") (mut i32) (i32.const 8))
  (global (export "v") v128 (v128.const i32x4 1 2 3 4))
  (global (export "big") i64 (i64.const 5))
  (global (export "ext") externref (ref.null extern))
  (memory (export "mem") 1)
  (table (export "tab") 1 funcref)
  (tag (export "tag") (param i32))
  (func (export "default") (result i32) i32.const 99)
  (func (export "a-b") (result i32) i32.const 1)
  (func (export "") (result i32) i32.const 2)
  (func (export "setmg") (param i32) local.get 0 global.set 1)
  (func (export "getmg") (result i32) global.get 1))
-- t1.mjs --
import { p } from "./harness.mjs";
import * as ns from "./m.wasm";
import def, { add, g, mg, v, big, ext, mem, tab, tag, "a-b" as ab, "" as empty, setmg, getmg } from "./m.wasm";
p("keys", () => Reflect.ownKeys(ns).map(String));
p("tag", () => Object.prototype.toString.call(ns));
p("add", () => add(2, 3));
p("add is the export", () => add === ns.add);
p("globals", () => [g, mg, v, big, ext]);
p("a global is its value once", () => { setmg(10); return [mg, getmg()]; });
p("memory", () => [mem instanceof WebAssembly.Memory, mem.buffer.byteLength]);
p("table", () => tab instanceof WebAssembly.Table);
p("tag", () => tag instanceof WebAssembly.Tag);
p("default", () => def());
p("names", () => [ab(), empty()]);
p("descriptor", () => { const d = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(ns, "g"); return [d.value, d.writable, d.enumerable, d.configurable]; });
p("namespace =", () => { "use strict"; ns.g = 1; });
-- t2.mjs --
import { p, pa } from "./harness.mjs";
import * as ns from "./m.wasm";
import source m from "./m.wasm";
import source again from "./m.wasm";
p("source", () => [m instanceof WebAssembly.Module, m === again]);
p("source exports", () => WebAssembly.Module.exports(m).map(e => e.name + ":" + e.kind));
p("source tag", () => [Object.prototype.toString.call(m), Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(Object.getPrototypeOf(WebAssembly.Module.prototype), Symbol.toStringTag).get.call(m)]);
p("abstract module source", () => [Object.getPrototypeOf(WebAssembly.Module).name, Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(Object.getPrototypeOf(WebAssembly.Module.prototype), Symbol.toStringTag).get.call({})]);
p("instance of the source", () => new WebAssembly.Instance(m).exports.add(1, 1));
pa("import.source", async () => (await import.source("./m.wasm")) === m);
pa("import()", async () => (await import("./m.wasm")) === ns);
-- t3.mjs --
import { p } from "./harness.mjs";
import { add, g } from "./reexport.mjs";
import * as re from "./reexport.mjs";
p("re-exported", () => [add(4, 5), g, Object.keys(re)]);
-- reexport.mjs --
export * from "./m.wasm";
export { add as plus } from "./m.wasm";
